focus: Example run. Every field the dashboard reads appears at least once.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.verdict: Strong match. They want the discovery-to-rollout work you already do, and they name your stack.
strengths: Owns proof of concept through production, which is the job you have held twice
Names the tools you use daily in the first three bullets
gaps: Wants Kubernetes depth you do not have
Remote is likely US-residence, so ask early

postings.title: Automation Consultant
postings.verdict: Good contract fit and billable from anywhere. Scope is vague, so ask what the first project actually is.
strengths: Exactly the integration work you have shipped for two clients
gaps: Rate sits below your target band, though above your floor

postings.title: Platform Engineer
postings.verdict: Onsite in Austin, and only confirmed on the board that sent the alert. Visible so you can judge it, not recommended.
strengths: Infrastructure work is adjacent to what you do
gaps: Could not confirm on the employer's own careers page

postings.title: Solutions Architect
postings.verdict: Closed. The posting 404s, so the dashboard drops it and the count of dropped roles goes in the run note.
